items.html: And in ZON there is another deficiency, for the more the Partzufim proceed and descend from their level, the more their separation is revealed — the aspect of Mah from the aspect of Ban. Therefore the separation increases in the portion of Mah and Ban that is in ZON. The matter is that ZA is entirely the aspect of Mah, and the Nukva is entirely the aspect of Ban, and they are separate, at times back to back and at times face to face.
